Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Denza Z! 

It’s an absolutely insane Chinese hypercar that offers absolutely insane power for a relatively affordable price! 

The question is, can an all-new Chinese brand create a car to compete with the European elite? Let’s take a closer look - starting with the performance stats! 

The Denza Z is an all-electric supercar with a tri-motor set-up - one motor at the front, and two at the rear. The three of these combine to produce an eye-watering 1,600hp, which can propel the Z to 62 mph in around 2 seconds, and it comes with a top speed of 217mph. The edition we have here, with the metal roof, tips the scales at 2,580kg.
